recap:
Joe Rogan sits down with Joe DeRosa, a multi-talented entertainer who wears many hats as a comedian, musician, actor, and podcaster. DeRosa brings a lot of energy to the conversation, discussing his latest comedy special 'I Never Promised You a Rose Garden' which is available to watch on YouTube. The two dive deep into what it takes to create quality comedy content in today's landscape and how DeRosa approaches his craft from multiple angles.

The conversation naturally flows between DeRosa's various creative pursuits, exploring how his work as a musician informs his comedy and vice versa. DeRosa seems comfortable discussing the vulnerability required to put yourself out there as an artist, whether on stage or in other mediums. Joe and Joe riff on the challenges and rewards of the entertainment industry, touching on how comedy has evolved and what audiences are looking for. Throughout the episode, there's genuine chemistry between the two as they trade stories and observations about performing, creating content, and staying authentic in a constantly changing media landscape.
